items.title: Pay outstanding Reitbeteiligung fees for April and May 2026
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie die 240,00 € bis zum 10.06.2026, damit wir die Reitzeiten für Juni wie gewohnt einplanen können.
items.computation: The letter is a payment reminder from a private business (Reitstall Beispielhof), not a German authority, so the statutory deemed-delivery rules (§§ 187, 188, 193 BGB extensions etc.) for administrative letters do not apply; the due date is simply the calendar date printed in the text. The body text states the transfer must happen 'bis zum 10.06.2026' (by 10 June 2026). Checked against the NW holiday calendar, 10 June 2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday, so no weekend/holiday shift is needed. Note: the payment-information box below separately states 'Fälligkeit: 19.06.2026', a later date, creating a contradiction within the letter; following the rule to use the earliest plausible date when a letter contradicts itself, 10.06.2026 is used as the due date, with reduced confidence.

warnings: The letter gives two different dates for the same payment: the body text says 'bis zum 10.06.2026' while the payment-information box states 'Fälligkeit: 19.06.2026' (nine days later); the earlier date (10.06.2026) was used as the due date to be safe, but the sender should be asked which date is correct.

The IBAN DE28 3705 0198 0007 7441 00 is well-formed and its bank code/name match the letterhead (Musterbank AG), but a valid IBAN does not prove who owns the account; confirm the payee name matches 'Reitstall Beispielhof' / 'Familie Beispielhof' via your bank's mandatory payee-name check before transferring.
